scripts.provision:hpvn: npx -y firebase-tools@latest firestore:databases:create burrow-game --location=asia-southeast1 --project hpvnn && npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:sites:create hpvnn-burrow --project hpvnn
scripts.deploy:hpvn: npm run build && npm run functions:build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:burrow-game,functions:burrow-game,hosting:burrow --project hpvnn
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:burrow --project hpvnn
